rules.v1: saved action receipts available to that answer
rules.v2: receipts for the request being answered; each field measures only what its name says, only for that request

rules.v1: what the assistant or system is able to do, with no record state
rules.v2: a general offer of help — what the assistant could do next — that states no operational fact

three kinds of can/cannot: general offer = CAPABILITY; tool/path available or not in this session = ASSERTED; platform policy/operational capability = ASSERTED; checkable against session policy, offered tools or evidence; can/cannot alone never makes them NON_ASSERTION; never infer unavailability from a tool not being called

rules.v1: (none beyond 'absence from incomplete records never proves…')
rules.v2: system-wide non-existence needs a source covering that scope; an unretrieved document/annex proves neither content nor emptiness; a conclusion from an unestablished premise is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not SUPPORTED; an explicit status, tracked field or complete listing can support a negative within its scope

check receipts for claims about an action in this request; read each receipt only for what it measures (no proposal ≠ no other action; nothing in this request ≠ never); a receipt that explicitly covers a request-limited claim supports it
RFC 6901 JSON Pointers into the input, starting /sources/ or /receipts/, ~0/~1 escaping, dots literal, array index
